title: 0.2.23 rollback dependency-tree fix
summary: This update fixes OTA rollback when a source-tree install contains frontend/node_modules or other development-only directories.
highlights: Rollback backup and restore now exclude frontend, tests, docs, launcher and nested node_modules trees.
The file-copy fallback now treats bare excluded directory names as matching any path segment, not only the root segment.
This prevents pnpm/Ant Design dependency paths from breaking rollback after a failed update.
Regression tests cover both rollback backup and nested node_modules copy exclusion.
compatibility: No data migration is required. Existing history, user plugins and local config are preserved.
